player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Lorax''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|Bring Him Before Me]] list on DeckTech in December 2001.

starting.card: Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place

description: This is the crazy Dark Deck that I used to win the Last Man Standing at worlds.  It was 2-2 at World, but with better playtesting I could have done much better in both of those games.
cards: Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place
posted: Dr E. and Ponda Boba
posted: I have You Now x3
notes: Posted 3 December 2001, before Theed Palace, so the format is Premiere - Reflections III. The post says this is the deck the author used to win the Last Man Standing at Worlds and went 2-2 with it at Worlds.

Starting (9) as posted: Bring Him Before Me, Insignificant Rebellion, Your Destiny, Death Star II: Throne Room, 'Starting Effect' (not named), Prepared Defenses, Crush The Rebellion, Imperial Arrest Order & Secret Plans, No Escape; these count toward the 60.
'Starting Effect' is printed as written because the post does not name it.

'Destiny 7's x16' is printed as written. The strategy says they were a mix of Visage, Intruder Missles, Imperial Artillery, We're the Bait and Closed Door (and mentions The Phantom Menace) without counts.

Posted 'EPP Vader' dested Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'EPP Maul' dested Darth Maul With Lightsaber; 'Emperor' dested Emperor Palpatine; 'IG-88 with Gun' dested IG-88 With Riot Gun; 'Dr E. and Ponda Boba' dested Dr. Evazan & Ponda Baba; 'Accelerate our Plans' dested We Must Accelerate Our Plans; 'Counter Assualt' dested Counter Assault.
Posted 'Naboo Docking Bay' dested Naboo: Theed Palace Docking Bay (Dark); the strategy mentions switching from the Cloud City docking bay to the Naboo one.
